content: The staff should not feel this comfortable being so aggressive and disrespectful toward customers. It’s genuinely concerning, and frankly unacceptable. It’s hard to understand how this behavior has been allowed to continue without intervention from NJIT or Gourmet Dining. Something needs to change.

Pretty good until the fountain drink CO2 needs to be changed. They seem to be slow on purpose when guests let them know. It’s probably just me, but I wanted to comment to see if others experience the same thing.  On top of the fountain machine issue, my food was subpar in comparison to usual. Regardless, it’s pretty good most days. Today it was a bad experience.

I walk up to order and the manager immediately gives me attitude for not hearing “for here or to go” so he cuts me off and asks again. So I responded with the same level of volume and he immediately threatens to not take my order and an argument ensues. Tells me to “step aside” for a “conversation” so I laugh and he proceeds to kick me out and call public safety. Outrageous gaul on this man.

Worst place around ever, all of them are rude and not helpful at all. Literally all of them are acting like they are doing a favor to the customer. They took over 20 minutes for a burger while the place was empty, they didn’t have any shakes (or at least that’s what the people in the front said) and when asked what took too long to cook the guy talked shit back with explicit words “ You are crazy” I eat on smash all over Jersey and New York and never had trouble or such a bad experience as I did with these guys.

Absolutely disgusting in terms of wait time
Ended up late to class after spending 50 minutes waiting for my food. Do not come here, seriously.
I don’t usually leave reviews but the staff were not friendly at all and their attitude was so aggressive. Very unprofessional

Worst smash burger I’ve been to, rude Custmer service and disgusting attitude, I got a milkshake that it’s 6$ I got half cup and when I asked I was told to save place for the whip cream and when I explained that I dont want whip cream I was told that I have to get it the same way as if I asked for one. Will never be back!
Very expensive! I’ve never seen a chicken burger with fries cost $21. They’re taking advantage of their location, surrounded by students, to overcharge for food that shouldn’t be this expensive.

Every time I go here, I pay a lot of money and wait a long time for them to get my order wrong. The shakes are pretty good, but something is wrong with their take-out system.

I ordered a large avocado bacon burger with no tomato today. Three times I was handed an order, twice the cook called them back and said no no that’s not hers. The third time the manager stepped in and packed the order for me. I was there long enough to get extra sauce and everything. All I ordered was a burger and I paid over $8 for them to get it wrong. Disappointing all around.

Wait to ORDER regularly exceeds 15-20 minutes.  Never open a second register.  Waited 35 minutes for my burger AFTER ordering today.  Almost an hour total.  They also don’t accept any smashburger coupons or promotions.  Take your business elsewhere.

Shonique was rude. I asked if I could use a reward I obtained from the smashburger app, and she said no which is fine, but proceeds to tell me that the cheapest burger they have is the classic smash. Assuming a customer will not want other (more expensive) options when unable to use a reward is extremely rude.  I then proceed to stand in an open space to which she calls me back and tell me that I am obstructing the way for the other employee to walk pass. That's something someone else could have told me when they needed me to move. I plan on not coming to this store again. Also, a cup for water is $2.29, because they also charge for tap.

As a working professional taking night classes, stopped in for a quick bite.  Asked for a burger with no lettuce, tomatoes, or mayo.  Was told by cashier can only take 2 things off a sandwich. I'm paying same price for less ingredients and you can't do this? No thanks  not worth the time or hassle, avoid.

If there was 0 stars, I would've chosen it. Waited an hour for four BURGER sandwiches. I didn't mind the wait, becasue they werr busy.. But to get my orders wrong, this means their crew didn't complete their trainings 😂.. worst place ever. Trucks around it are a lot cheaper and better 👍🏼

The hours listed is not correct.  Went there around 7pm and it's already closed even though the website clearly states 8pm closing.  No idea what the actual hours are and the phone number doesn't reach anyone.

Absolutely awful! Absolutely befitting of a “NEWARK” hood nasty urban restaurant... what is to be expected of any big time fast food restaurant who’s gained such notoriety and success in every suburban neighborhood prior to this addition... once they get to Newark are core values and principles OUT to the dump.
Came here with my app ready to redeem my reward and I was told that they don’t HONOR it. After my rude as hell “have a nice day” from the poetic justice Janet Jackson wanna be I knew I’d have to review this place. Thanks google
Decent burgers but charging for water (even a cup) No no no that’s a 1 Star review for these scam artists.  Plenty of better burger places for cheaper prices and free water.
Worst service possible. Waited half an hour on line to get to the register and be told there is another 15 minute wait! Want to waste your time and money... Best place to go!
The worst place ever, I literally had to wait for 50 minuets to get my order and it was all wrong!!! I will never go there again!
customer service is the worst. the lady is scratching her wig and did not wear gloves VERY DISGUSTING

Stay away...far away! Orders are wrong and the wait time is ridiculous. Management and wait staff are not friendly and do not listen to the customer. No apologies, no smile, no thank you. Just attitude.

Was Closed both times I went..
I guess if College kids are Not around, no business for nobody Else 😒
The women was absolutely nasty with me once I approached the register. I will not be buying from a place with nasty service.
The worst place I’ve seen in my life, the customer service very nasty and they have a disgusting attitude. I will never come to this place again, Don’t ever try it
The location was not open i go there different days and times the store is never open
Been by two times, separate days, during business hours and both times not open. Note to owner or manager, put up hours and signs when closed. Thanks!

I visit this Smashburger while I was traveling on Wednesday Jan 21 2020 and the food was not up to par no seasoning on the meat just tasted like beef sorry unseasoned beef worst $8 I spent for burgers
Awful....There are so many better options than this "Particular Smash Burger".. Its awful.. no joke
The hours posted are a lie. I drove here and it was closed.
The wait is way to long and the prices are double . 30 minute wait on BURGERS  is crazy ...
ive traveled here 3 times and its never been open for business
Kicked me out where I sat to eat. Dont they close at 8? Its 5pm.
Fantastic food, fantastic service, love the smash tots ❤️❤️❤️

Great location.

Ordered on the app and and the time being ready was correct.

The staff was friendly.

Excellent burger and price is better than any fast food burger.

Tons of options for toppings.
Location is closed
The food is hot so be careful. The store manager is very helpful and willing to fix any issues.

The best casual dining at NJIT!! The staff are wonderful as well! TANAYA, Aneesha, and the GM Laron are exceptionally nice and professional. The grill operator Roland creates visually appealing and delicious food😇🙂🙂🙂

I went to this location for the first time today and I will say not only was the food prepared well and tasted delicious, but the MANAGER was soooo friendly and made everything was very accessible to me as I am in a wheelchair. He made sure everything was perfect with my order and kept checking to make sure I was okay and satisfied. I will definitely be coming back! Thank you :)
I absolutely loved Smashburger! The service and cleanliness of the restaurant was amazing! Not to mention it may be one of the best burgers in town!
Best burger ever

I love the Oreo milkshake it's only $6. The store's always clean and the workers are quick and communicate well when I place my orders. I really miss the Mac and Cheese burgers PLEASE BRING THEM BACK THEY WERE SO GOOD :(

I’m Re-reviewing this location for a 3rd time giving the store back 3 more stars because the female manager today was kind, polite & understanding why my order was messed up. She deserves a few stars because she noticed this is an ongoing issue with staff and student ordering on the mobile app. Please make sure to stress u don’t want any sauce or mayo. And if u do- it’s very Heavy.
We Thank you!! 😊
**Side Note: the location being closed entirely on Saturdays & Sundays is definitely hurting the business. Most weekends, students look elsewhere for something different then campus food after a long week. Professors and community members alike. Maybe the hours can be looked into? Especially when summer comes along & many students stay Newark residents all year. Thanks :)

It probably designed for the future when less people come here because it literally has only one register and maybe one cook to handle all the people came for opening week. But it’s confusing that they have ads all over the place prompt you to download their app to get discount while the register girl told me they don’t take coupons from their app. So the app is useless here. Nothing can be redeemed and no point will be earned. The service are better compared to other traditional fast food chain. Most people love their burgers but I find the avocado in mine is not the best quality.
Crispy Brussels are delicious! The NJ burger also pretty good. Everyone was very nice, service was quick. All in all a quick, good place to grab a burger.
It was really good i had the classic burger. Yummy

The food is good like any other Smash Burger location, but I'm dinging them for not accepting the coupons that I get from Smash in my email. There's a lot seating here so the place is spacious. The staff is relatively friendly and they get your food out fairly quickly.

I spend about $200 a month here and it's worth every penny. Everyone there is friendly and quick to attend a customer or ask if there's anything else they can do.  And of course, the burgers are delicious (though I only order the same thing and they know what my order is by this time). 10/10, would spend a chunk of my paycheck on them again.
Amazing burgers and milk shake....salted caramel with whipped cream is ♥️

One of the females in the kitchen was very loud and obnoxious. When I was getting my food I heard her say “what she keep staring at me for”. The person that took my order was nice with helping me. However I won’t return to this specific location

I've had Smasburger and this place was off. After a really long wait, I expected the burger to be top notch, but it wasn't. The people in front of me were also waiting a while even after I got there. It wasn't particularly too busy even though I did go around lunch time. The staff were friendly. The soda machine was out of ice, and there was water on the floor around the machine. Don't expect this to be a quick grab and go type of place. Expect to spend at least 20-30 mins waiting for your order.

I am so psyched that Smashburger came to this campus!  I had tried the restaurant once before in a distant NJ location and was pleased to see all the menu options.  The shakes are fantabulous. I ran into a mob scene my first time, around 1pm, and service was still exceptional for a fast food restaurant.  Next time, I'll go at 11am for lunch.  I hope they make online ordering available soon.
Best smashburger location I ever been too. Food cooked to order.  Nothing left around then given to you.  Everything was fresh. The whole staff was amazing, nice and communicated efficiently.

Good food and good service! the food isn't the cheapest, but it's good! Since they are part of the campus dining services they do take NJIT cards, but not smash gift cards for some reason. The milkshakes are great for stress eating!

these lower reviews need to take a chill pill. This place just opened a week ago on a freaking college campus where the students wanted this restaurant to be there of course its going to get packed especially if you go from 1-8 on most days. The food was great and the service was fair for being recently opened

Great place.  Had the burger with truffle, mushrooms, and swiss. It was fantastic(although a bit too salty) and the service was some of the best I've ever seen! Wish I had a picture to share. Wanted to go back for dinner that same day for the same burger. Enjoy!

The food is alright. It's about standard for a burger joint. However, it's pretty pricey for its mediocrity. Being on a college campus, I think pricey restaurants like this are taking advantage of the students in the area. It's okay if you've got money to burn, but I wouldn't recommend it if you're strapped for cash.
